INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

2. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

5. B — 100 °C

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.

7. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

9. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. C — Producers

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

12. B — Ice melting to water
